title: Output of government-tenders-api
description: Results of government-tenders-api: the notices dataset (table view and all fields) and the run summary.

resultsDatasetUrl.title: Notices
resultsDatasetUrl.description: One row per public tender or award notice matching the filters: title, buyer, country, type, status, value, publication date, deadline and notice link (table columns only; allFieldsDatasetUrl has every field).

allFieldsDatasetUrl.title: Notices (all fields)
allFieldsDatasetUrl.description: Same rows with every field of the dataset schema (CPV/NAICS/UNSPSC codes, description snippet, procedure, award date, suppliers, source URLs), as JSON

runSummary.title: Run summary
runSummary.description: Run summary (key-value record RUN_SUMMARY): rows delivered, charged events, matches, shards read, index build time, errors, failure class and duration
